findings.title: NPE on concurrent group deletion still present in subgroup stream methods
findings.body: The new null check was only added to getSubGroupsCount(), but getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer) at line 262, and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) at line 268 still call modelSupplier.get() and dereference the result. When a cached group is deleted concurrently, getGroupModel() returns null and these methods throw the same NPE. The fix should handle a null delegate consistently for all delegating methods or make the supplier throw a controlled exception.

findings.title: Concurrency test asserts before reader thread finishes
findings.body: The test starts the reader thread at line 139, deletes groups, sets deletedAll=true, and then immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty without joining the reader thread. The reader can still be inside the groups(...) call and can add an exception after the assertion, so an NPE regression can pass unnoticed. If a deletion throws before deletedAll is set, the non-daemon thread also keeps looping forever. Join the thread (or use an ExecutorService and shut it down in a finally block) before asserting.
